d: Ruiyan confronts Baishan about the plagiarism of her product. Seeing Ruiyan's research and development log, it brings back Baishan's memory about young Jiang Feng. Baishan decides to let Ruiyan join his company.

t: The Love Trap - EP 10 / 穿越谜情
d: PeiYa is uneasy after hearing MuLan and ChenMei's conversation. Modern-day KeMing does not force PeiYa to reveal what she knows, and merely advises her to make her own judgement instead of blindly believing MuLan.

t: Suji & Uri - EP 5 / 幸运的我们
d: Cai Douli is unfairly made to pay for clothes damaged by someone else. Refusing to let her hard-earned money go to waste, she sets out to find the person truly responsible and stages a protest outside the company entrance.
